title: Standing Cable Chest Press  - Technique, Benefits, and Common Mistakes
creator: Mike | J2FIT Strength & Conditioning
description:
Standing cable chest press — technique, benefits, and the mistakes that turn it into a core exercise.

Every J2FIT program, one app, $29/mo → https://j2fit.com/app

Standing cable pressing gives you constant tension through the full range and a strong contracted position that dumbbells can't match. But it only works if you can stay anchored.

0:00 Introduction to exercise
0:23 Equipment setup
0:43 Execution and technique
1:28 Expert tips for form
2:10 Common mistakes to avoid
3:17 Programming and integration

HOW TO DO IT:
- Stagger your stance, one foot forward
- Cables set at chest height
- Brace your core, press forward and slightly inward
- Squeeze at full extension, control the return

COMMON MISTAKES:
- Getting pulled backward — the weight is too heavy
- Square stance with no base
- Letting the torso rotate
- Treating it as a core exercise instead of a chest exercise

SETS & REPS: 3 sets of 10-15 reps
